title: Registered Occupants and Occupant Charges on a Home-Site Lease
content:
Every adult aged 18 or over who lives in a home on a Home-Site Lease site must be registered on the lease after screening, and the household may never exceed the lot class's most persons of any age.

**Rules for changing the household**

- Occupants are added or removed only while the lease is active or notice to vacate, as the lease record shows.
- Each adult added is screened for the lot class's application fee per adult, posted as an application fee on the registration date.
- The occupant charge for adults beyond the adults included in the site rent changes from the billing period after the registration date.
- A removal stops the charge from the billing period after the departure is reported, without retroactive credit.
- A guest is not an occupant; guest stays are governed by the community rules program.

**Points of judgement (hypothetical household on a lot class including two adults, 30.00 per further adult)**

| Change | Effect |
|---|---|
| A third adult is registered on 12 May | application fee posted on 12 May; occupant charge of 30.00 a month from the June billing period |
| The third adult moves out and the departure is reported on 20 August | occupant charge stops from the September billing period; no credit for any part of August |
| A visiting relative stays for two weeks | a guest, not an occupant; governed by the community rules program |
| An adult would be added to a lease in default | not possible; occupants change only on an active or notice-to-vacate lease |
| An addition would bring the household above the lot class's limit of persons of any age | not possible; the household may never exceed that limit |
